{{Citation}}
A '''Loremaster''' was an expert in the folklore and history of their culture, race, and/or [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

==History==
The [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Gjarshi]] was a loremaster for the [[Black Rakata]].<ref name="KotOR" />

Dancers were also important in Askajian culture. A skilled dancer acted as a [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] and loremaster, re-enacting tribal history and legend and leading worship of their main goddess, the [[Moon Lady]].

[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]] was a loremaster of the [[One Sith]], possessing a vast knowledge of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] lore, rituals, [[Sith sorcery/Legends|magics]], and history.
